mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, c.owner AS owner, c.follow_time AS followTime, COALESCE(t.contractAmount, 0) AS contractAmount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS contractAmount FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '') GROUP BY customer_id ) t ON t.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.in_shared_pool = 0 AND c.owner IS NOT NULL AND c.owner != '' AND (c.follow_time IS NULL OR c.follow_time < #{staleBefore}) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.contractAmount, 0) DESC, c.follow_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, organization_id AS organizationId, action_type AS actionType, agent_id AS agentId, customer_id AS customerId, customer_name AS customerName, owner_id AS ownerId, payload, status, result, confirm_user AS confirmUser, confirm_time AS confirmTime, create_user AS createUser, update_user AS updateUser, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM ai_employee_action WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT customer_id FROM ai_employee_action WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'REJECTED' AND confirm_time IS NOT NULL AND confirm_time > #{quietBefore} GROUP BY customer_id
